name: Logitech G435 Ultra-Lightweight Wireless Bluetooth Gaming Headset - Off-White & Lilac (No USB Dongle)
description: Selling an authentic Logitech G435 Wireless Gaming Headset in the stylish Off-White and Lilac purple colorway. Weighing a featherlight 165 grams, it provides incredible fatigue-free comfort for all-day listening, music streaming, or online classes. PLEASE NOTE: This listing does NOT include the original LIGHTSPEED USB wireless receiver (dongle). However, the headset features built-in low-lag Bluetooth that connects flawlessly to smartphones, tablets, iPads, MacBooks, laptops, or Nintendo Switch for wireless audio out of the box! Can also be used for parts or paired with a replacement G435 receiver if you already have one. Equipped with 40mm high-fidelity audio drivers and advanced built-in dual beamforming microphones. Battery life is up to 18 hours per charge via USB-C. Clean cosmetic condition with minor signs of light use, thoroughly cleaned and sanitized. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a cat; the unit has been carefully air-blown, deep-vacuumed, and fully disinfected prior to listing.
contact_note: Includes the headset only; does NOT include the original LIGHTSPEED USB wireless receiver or charging cable. It functions perfectly via Bluetooth mode for smartphones/laptops. Since this is a personal audio item, it does NOT come with an additional fabric carrying storage bag. Please bring a small bag or pouch for transport during local pickup. Rest assured that although the device comes from a cat-friendly home, it has been deeply disinfected and cleaned, though faint pet traces may remain. Pricing tiers are adjusted low and smooth for quick sale!
meta_description: Logitech G435 wireless gaming headset (Off-White/Lilac) missing USB dongle. Functions perfectly via Bluetooth mode for smartphones and laptops. Cleaned and sanitized.
name_zh: Logitech 罗技 G435 极轻量无线蓝牙游戏头戴耳机 - 白紫拼色 (无USB接收器)
description_zh: 转让一台正品 Logitech（罗技）G435 无线头戴游戏耳机，高颜值清新的白紫拼色。重量仅有165克，久戴完全不压头。**请务必注意：本物品没有原装的 LIGHTSPEED USB 无线接收器（Dongle）。** 但耳机内置的原生低延迟蓝牙功能完全正常，可以完美无线连接手机、iPad、平板、MacBook、笔记本电脑、以及 Nintendo Switch 进行听歌游戏，或者买回去当做配件/找通用接收器配对。内置 40mm 动圈单元和双波束成形麦克风，Type-C 续航约18小时。外观有正常微弱使用痕迹，已做清洁。卖家家里养猫，发布前已进行深度吸尘并用酒精全面消毒擦拭。因缺失接收器，超低价梯度诚出！
